name: Tiered Dessert Carrier with Cover
material: Printed board tiers and outer cover; support and handle specification confirmed for the loaded arrangement
structure: Graduated circular dessert tiers with a central carry-handle arrangement and a removable tapered outer cover
intro: Combine a tiered dessert presentation and an outer carry cover in one packaging brief. This construction differs from a single-level cake carton, cylindrical gift box or raised rectangular catering tray. The reference arrangement shows several dessert levels; dimensions, tier count and supplied components are confirmed for your project rather than taken as a fixed capacity.
measure: Overall closed height and diameter, each tier diameter, vertical clearance, dessert sizes and total filled mass
checks: Specify the portion height as well as the tier footprint so the outer cover does not contact the desserts.
Review the centre support, handle, tier assembly and carrying balance with a fully loaded sample; no weight rating is inferred from the image.
Confirm food-facing liners, holding conditions and whether the quotation includes the tiers, cover and any decorative accessories.
question: How should I choose a tiered dessert carrier size?
answer: List the dessert count, footprint and maximum height for each level, plus the complete filled mass. Review usable tier areas, clearance between levels, central support and closed cover size together. Approve a fully loaded sample; changing tier count alone does not establish carrying capacity.
distinct: Graduated dessert tiers within a removable tapered carry cover, not the existing one-level cake carriers or plain cylindrical gift boxes. Tier-count and artwork variants are consolidated.

name: Printed Corrugated Shipping Carton
material: Printed corrugated board; flute, liners and closure method confirmed against the packed goods
structure: Rectangular shipping carton with closing top panels intended for a separately confirmed sealing method
intro: A printed outer shipping carton for goods that need a transport pack instead of a presentation-style hinged mailer. Specify the packed internal dimensions, board construction and sealing method around the actual contents and distribution route. The photograph does not establish a standardized box code, strength grade or tested shipping performance.
measure: Maximum packed length, width and height, protective material allowance, filled mass, stack and shipping conditions
checks: Distinguish required usable internal dimensions from the external shipping dimensions.
Agree the closing-panel design and tape or other sealing method; verify any automation requirements against the approved dieline.
Confirm board and protective packing by the goods and route, and request the relevant packed-carton checks rather than assuming a strength rating.
question: How does this differ from a hinged mailer box?
answer: This is an outer shipping-carton brief with a separately agreed sealing method, while a hinged mailer is planned around its integrated presentation lid and locking panels. Specify the contents, internal size, mass, closure workflow and route before comparing board construction and packed dimensions.
distinct: Transport outer carton with closing panels and a confirmed sealing workflow, distinct from the existing hinged presentation mailer and tear-open postal carton.
